title: Ways to earn
line: Choose what members do to earn points, stamps or cashback.
chooseLine: Configure one of the methods available in your program.
heroLine: Start with your everyday earning rules. Add welcome, birthday and referral bonuses when you are ready.
searchHint: Search by name or earning method
modifiers: Level multipliers and boost events may change the final amount.
noResults: No earning methods match these filters.
editLine: Set a clear earning rate and check the member example.
currency: Use − / + or type the amount. Your program currency is {{currency}}.
eligible: Completed bookings and desk purchases when enabled
sharedRate: This base rate is shared across your program. Booking and desk earning are switched on separately.
advancedLine: Review rounding and the modifiers used by your program.
calculation: The final award is rounded down to whole points after the applicable level, outlet, benefit and promotion multipliers. Overlapping boosts use the highest matching boost.
deskLine: Keep desk purchases connected to their existing earning rules.
finalAmount: Final earning follows the member’s level, active boosts and program rules.
separateLine: Spendable points and level qualification are calculated separately.
unsaved: Changes stay here until you save.
bonusLine: Reward key moments with a welcome, birthday or referral bonus.
bonusHeroLine: Keep each bonus easy to understand: who gets it, when it is awarded and how many points they receive.
pickAmount: Choose an amount or type your own.
messageNote: Changing this amount does not send a campaign. Member messages follow your communication settings.
sharedRulesLine: These rules apply across your loyalty program.
qualificationLine: Level qualification can use points, visits or spend. Keep it separate from the points balance members can spend.
invalidExample: Enter a valid rate and a non-negative purchase amount to see the example.
saved: Saved. Your program settings are up to date.
discardLine: Your unsaved earning settings will be discarded. Changes already saved stay in place.
stampLine: A full card gives a reward
